name: Divinely Faded
address_never: the future downtown shop address (new shop, unpublished until it opens)
a private registered-agent address (never published; kept out of this repo)
holidays: Open on holidays at regular hours; $20 holiday fee on the holiday itself.
policy: No-shows and late cancellations may be charged a cancellation fee (Booksy). Payment is due in full after the service.

services.name: Essential Haircut
services.desc: Precision haircut tailored to your style and head shape, straight razor neck cleanup, finished style.

services.name: Signature Cut
services.desc: Precision haircut, beard trim or line-up, hot towel finish and straight razor detailing. The most popular service.

services.name: Luxury Grooming Experience
services.desc: Consultation, haircut, beard sculpt, wash and scalp massage, facial steam, dual hot towels, straight razor detailing, basic hair design, ear and nose waxing, styling and a luxury fragrance finish.

services.name: Straight Razor Beard Shave
services.desc: Traditional wet shave with hot towels, premium shaving cream and a soothing aftershave.

services.name: Head & Beard Shave
services.desc: Precision head shave and beard shave with hot towels and a soothing aftershave balm.

services.name: Express Facial
services.desc: Facial massage, warm steam, deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation and hydrating moisturizer.

services.name: Deluxe Facial
services.desc: Facial massage, warm steam, gentle exfoliation, hydrating moisturizer, advanced skin treatments and an anti-aging serum.

services.name: Color Transformation
services.desc: Professional coloring including bleaching and toning to reach the shade you want.

services.name: Perm
services.desc: Customized perm for volume, texture and movement.

owner_answers_2026_10_24: Via Colin (iMessage 2026-10-24 18:40): 303 S Halagueno; the new downtown shop has no date; Sat 8-2; no walk-ins (looking for an employee first); cash, card, Zelle, Cash App; started cutting 2023; Booksy face photos OK and a new photo set coming; will send perm + new-shop photos; leave out LGBTQ+ and wheelchair; no beard dye or capillary treatment, new menu later; open on holidays with a $20 fee. Bible verses: ESV, full verse (Colin 20:03). Not answered: weekday hours, parking, opening month, whether Tim speaks Spanish, Latino-owned.
